_comment: Scene for the ship details window. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: ship_stats_window
windows._note: Placed by the game code at 500,100; each further ship window opened in the same game sits 50 px left of and 20 px below the one before. With the mod the window's rectangle is 10x10 and its content is drawn 258 px to the right of that point, beside the 740 px fleet panel (A4).
windows._hide_note: Stats tab of a ship without a captain or air wings: the code hides those blocks and the History tab.

captures.name: history

text_field: Took part in the Battle of the River Plate against HMS Exeter, HMS Ajax and HMNZS Achilles.

captures._render_note: Sample rows: a 1936 ship has no history.

steps._note: Home Fleet in the British navy overview. Raw position inside a vanilla panel.
its first ship, the carrier HMS Furious

manual: Tooltips on stat tiles and sea terrain adjusters
Renaming the ship, Pride of the Fleet, Delete, Promote of a captain (also with shift+z)
States a 1936 start does not show: a captain (card at the top right, and on a carrier the wing card under it), history entries and medals
checklist: Stats tab of a ship without captain or air wings: the panel is 794 wide and nothing stands beside it
The title strip with the title, manpower, fuel, delete and close; the identity card with the class icon, the name field and the experience
Every stat on its tile; the picture band under the Misc card with the class picture, Pride of the Fleet, dominance and support values and the four sea terrain adjusters
A carrier: the Air Wings card beside the panel at the top, its rows inside the card
History tab: the summary card (Honors, captain experience) and the dark list card; no picture band
The window can be dragged by its panel and by the air wing card

states.name: captain
states._note: A ship with a captain and no air wings: not reachable in a 1936 start, drawn by the renderer only. The captain card is the background of captain_window, beside the panel.

states.name: carrier-captain
states._note: A carrier with a captain: the code is expected to put air_wings at taog_carrier_air_wings_list_position (1058,116), under the captain card. Render with --state carrier-captain --place air_wings=1058,116.
